name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Perform single-qubit state tomography in Qisk
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Perform single-qubit state tomography in Qiskit by hand: prepare RY(2.784) RZ(5.537)|0>, measure X, Y, Z expectation values with StatevectorEstimator, reconstruct the density matrix rho = (I + <X>X + <Y>Y + <Z>Z)/2, and report fidelity with the true state. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
